integrity: The proof derives the exact selected-part obstruction from the definition of certified domination, then applies explicit inclusion-exclusion. A definition-level exhaustive checker independently verifies the all-set criterion and polynomial coefficients on bounded orders and checks the K_{3,n} specialization.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The 2025 K_{3,n} polynomial is prior coverage of a genuine special case.
Finite exhaustive verification through order ten is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed arbitrary-multipartite enumerations.
title: Certified domination polynomial of complete multipartite graphs
